description: This file provides utility functions for handling JSON files, normalizing paths within a repository, running Vitest test suite reports, and collecting test durations. It is intended for use in a testing or report-generating context within a Node.js project.

methods.name: normalizeRepoPath
methods.description: Converts a file path to a normalized string with forward slashes.

methods.name: normalizeTrackedRepoPath
methods.description: Normalizes a given path relative to the repository root, handling absolute and relative paths.

methods.name: readJsonFile
methods.description: Reads a JSON file synchronously and parses its contents.

methods.name: tryReadJsonFile
methods.description: Attempts to read and parse a JSON file; returns a fallback value if reading fails.

methods.name: writeJsonFile
methods.description: Serializes a value as JSON and writes it to a file.

methods.name: runVitestJsonReport
methods.description: Executes Vitest test runner with JSON reporting, generating a report at a specified path.

methods.name: collectVitestFileDurations
methods.description: Processes Vitest report data to extract file durations and test counts.
